query: Implement the native iOS inspection screen for the product's workspace records. `.resonance/05_design.md` points to the approved workspace pattern: use the shared contextual drawer on wide layouts, and use the existing native sheet when its documented compact-width condition applies. A second app shares some components but has a different brand. Browser screenshots are unavailable.
expected_behavior: Reads the same applicable product intent through `.resonance/05_design.md` and its cited native source
Uses the documented native sheet condition as the bounded platform variant and otherwise preserves the approved default
Looks up the second app's own source rather than copying visual treatment from the shared component package
Uses native rendering and interaction evidence; does not require CSS token tooling or browser screenshots
Marks visual conformance unverified if the relevant native comparison evidence is unavailable
